topScam.title: The "Digital Arrest" Police Video Call
topScam.scam: A caller in uniform claims your Aadhaar or passport was found in an illegal parcel or money laundering probe. They place you on a fraudulent WhatsApp video call or custom video link with a backdrop resembling a police station, CBI, or ED cyber cell, declaring you are under 'Digital Arrest' and coercing you to transfer savings into a fake 'RBI verification escrow'.
topScam.protection: Indian law and law enforcement agencies have NO legal concept of 'Digital Arrest'. Police, CBI, ED, and customs NEVER conduct interrogations, trials, or arrests over video calls. Hang up immediately, block the number, and report to the National Cybercrime Portal or dial 1930.
topScam.sourceName: I4C & PM Mann Ki Baat Cyber Alert

realityPick.title: The Shadow AI & Trade Secret Exfiltration Blindspot
realityPick.myth: Our corporate HR policy bans public AI tools, so our trade secrets, source code, and customer data are secure.
realityPick.reality: Outright bans do not work—they create massive Shadow AI. Employees routinely paste customer PII, unreleased financial projections, and proprietary code into personal consumer web chats that train external public models.
realityPick.fix: Replace bans with an authorized enterprise AI proxy gateway featuring automated Data Loss Prevention (DLP), PII masking/redaction, comprehensive audit logs, and zero-data-retention enterprise agreements.
realityPick.impact: Unregulated employee AI usage leads to intellectual property leaks, customer PII exposure, and severe statutory fines under global data protection acts.
